author: Becky Fuger
text: We had a septic emergency on a Saturday.  Rohrer's was quickly recommended by 2 of our plumber friends. They came out right away.  Mike and Chad were friendly, professional and did a great job.  They were careful going around our trees with the truck and got to work cleaning out our septic tank.  We HIGHLY recommend them, especially if you live in a rural area like ours.

author: Ashley Davis
text: I had a bad experience with another septic company and was referred to this one by a co‑worker—and I’m so glad I was. They were absolutely amazing from start to finish. Everyone was courteous, kind, knowledgeable, and punctual. They were able to get us on the schedule the very next day and took care of everything we needed. I can’t thank them enough for coming out and helping us. Highly recommend!

author: David L
text: Excellent service!  The driver (Jimmy) contacted us when he was on the way.  He took care of our septic problem and was very good about answering questions about maintaining the system.  Definitely recommend!

author: Pastor Juan Cintron
text: Huge thanks to Rohrer’s Septic Tank & Tractor, especially Pat, for such great service. Pat was incredibly kind, patient, and attentive to our needs, taking the time to explain everything and making sure the job was done right. You can tell he truly cares about his customers. I highly recommend this company without hesitation

author: Micah Mobley
text: Was responsive, very easy to work with, and was able to quickly address concerns, all for a fair price.  Definitely will be using them for any future septic needs. Would absolutely recommend them if you need someone who is knowledgeable, communicative, efficient, and reasonable on prices.
